notes: Adding a pose that then never appeared was a save that failed and a toast that lied about it. Each pose was keeping the full-size picture as well as its thumbnail, a quarter of a megabyte, in the same store as every chat photo, and when that store is full the save fails; the app said so in its own toast, and the Pose library's "1 added" toast painted straight over it. Now the thumbnail is the only picture kept, at a size the pose reader is perfectly happy with, so a pose costs a few tens of kilobytes instead; the add toast reports what actually happened, how many went in and how many did not fit; and a failed save says how much the app is holding, in the toast and in the Troubleshooting log, so a full store is a fact rather than a mystery. Chat photos and galleries are the bulk of it, and removing some frees the space.
